Отступая назад от сдвинутой богини, он чуть не упал в высеченную в скале яму, которую скрывали её ноги. Она была круглой, целый ярд в поперечнике. Напрасно он пытался измерить глубину, бросая зажжённые спички. Они падали горящими и, так и не достигнув дна, всё ещё падая, гасли от ветра собственного полёта.", "source_sha256": "fa856b956215fc72408cd2ecb752cb55111e6a64f03118334f4ecb7853f3a010", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u017-r0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1394ac77477f7dd6761efc6ca9e4b0fa5520cbe906389d05a557d3fda8f31ac4"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u017-r0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“It looks very much like nothingness without a bottom,” he adjudged, as he dropped a tiny stone fragment.", "sha256": "32afafd3be9cb25c6f653a1884df9f5fde081db90431b7535d07e3c63fd56393", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1380]", "source_html": "

“It looks very much like nothingness without a bottom,” he adjudged, as he dropped a tiny stone fragment.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0049", "tag": "p", "text": "Many seconds they listened ere they heard it strike.", "sha256": "968de667b65e926d0d1538228d9320ba855afcbe323ddfd81f40153750f77a0b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1381]", "source_html": "

Many seconds they listened ere they heard it strike.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0050", "tag": "p", "text": "“Even that may not be the bottom,” Leoncia suggested. “It may have been struck against some projection from the side and even lodged there.”", "sha256": "3dc5e27865f81c0d160e7e7c70b4446849e590899e933175e7115f136c903a90", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1382]", "source_html": "

“Even that may not be the bottom,” Leoncia suggested. “It may have been struck against some projection from the side and even lodged there.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0051", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, this will determine it,” Francis cried, seizing an ancient musket from among the bones on the floor and preparing to drop it.", "sha256": "4cdd4600718ee8e698da7e13b20ea1d576a4488fe049ab5074501e1198ea1912", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1383]", "source_html": "

“Well, this will determine it,” Francis cried, seizing an ancient musket from among the bones on the floor and preparing to drop it.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0052", "tag": "p", "text": "But the old man stopped him.", "sha256": "cdc3e00130cd208cc76465d3828f566a2094af6800b302a3069f74caacf5630c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1384]", "source_html": "

But the old man stopped him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“The message of the sacred knots is: [[I]]whoso violates the nothingness beneath the feet of Chia shall quickly and terribly die[[/I]].”", "sha256": "10bdd8055aba607cbc30d8d897356c30b597d36fcffe32d5c76d7134f8ef85f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1385]", "source_html": "

“The message of the sacred knots is: whoso violates the nothingness beneath the feet of Chia shall quickly and terribly die.”

", "emphasis_spans": 1}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0054", "tag": "p", "text": "“Far be it from me to make a stir in the void,” Francis grinned, tossing the musket aside. “But what are we to do now, old Maya man? From the mouth of Chia to the ear of Hzatzl sounds easy——but how?—and what? Run the sacred knots with thy fingers, old top, and find for us [[I]]how[[/I]] and [[I]]what[[/I]].”", "sha256": "63f0d26416bfa117854847bc3170fe9549294f3a9e4b7e2da79d7354643e336e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1386]", "source_html": "

“Far be it from me to make a stir in the void,” Francis grinned, tossing the musket aside. “But what are we to do now, old Maya man? From the mouth of Chia to the ear of Hzatzl sounds easy——but how?—and what? Run the sacred knots with thy fingers, old top, and find for us how and what.”

", "emphasis_spans": 2}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0055", "tag": "p", "text": "For the son of the priest, the peon with the frayed knees, the clock had struck. All unaware, he had seen his last sun-rise. No matter what happened this day, no matter what blind efforts he might make to escape, the day was to be his last day. Had he remained on guard at the cave-entrance, he would surely have been killed by Torres and Mancheno, who had arrived close on his heels.", "sha256": "71c818740460cba63aa96ca52ba5f19136ea7b1611fd137e60123c4a694b6803", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1387]", "source_html": "

Thus, he missed death in the daylight under the sky. Yet the pace of the hands of the clock was unalterable, and neither nearer nor farther was his destined end from him.", "sha256": "9625ae96f13cfa4c5ec4d3bb85a194cbd9a3a844cbf3836adc04c51e00e4975c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1388]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0057", "tag": "p", "text": "While he scouted, Alvarez Torres and José Mancheno arrived at the cave-opening. The colossal, mother-of-pearl eyes of Chia on the wall of the cliff were too much for the superstition-reared Caroo.", "sha256": "f7f6cc9ae558c3dc106925d2cdd56a4c3d8c17f3bc8a5c9e431f102b62c6abcc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1389]", "source_html": "

While he scouted, Alvarez Torres and José Mancheno arrived at the cave-opening. The colossal, mother-of-pearl eyes of Chia on the wall of the cliff were too much for the superstition-reared Caroo.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0058", "tag": "p", "text": "“Do you go in,” he told Torres. “I will wait here and watch and guard.”", "sha256": "1ccb52e18e4bdb11d58df99305f3cfa370496ace19437ad9f86d8bb43f34acc7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1390]", "source_html": "

“Do you go in,” he told Torres. “I will wait here and watch and guard.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0059", "tag": "p", "text": "And Torres, with strong in him the blood of the ancient forebear who stood faithfully through the centuries in the avenue of the mummy dead, entered the Maya cave as courageously as that forebear had entered.", "sha256": "63303973cf72634231de149c00975da9241ff57dfb0c05f38173f67d8c7a6b05", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1391]", "source_html": "

And Torres, with strong in him the blood of the ancient forebear who stood faithfully through the centuries in the avenue of the mummy dead, entered the Maya cave as courageously as that forebear had entered.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0060", "tag": "p", "text": "And the instant he was out of sight, José Mancheno, unafraid to murder treacherously any living, breathing man, but greatly afraid of the unseen world behind unexplainable phenomena, forgot the trust of watch and ward and stole away through the jungle. Thus, the peon, returning reassured from his scout and curious to learn the Maya secrets of his father and of the sacred tassel, found nobody at the cave mouth and himself entered into it close upon the heels of Torres.", "sha256": "b748bdb55853105273ef08324190a1c5c06d06cc799910651e455a6f6d9bd635", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1392]", "source_html": "

And the instant he was out of sight, José Mancheno, unafraid to murder treacherously any living, breathing man, but greatly afraid of the unseen world behind unexplainable phenomena, forgot the trust of watch and ward and stole away through the jungle. Thus, the peon, returning reassured from his scout and curious to learn the Maya secrets of his father and of the sacred tassel, found nobody at the cave mouth and himself entered into it close upon the heels of Torres.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0061", "tag": "p", "text": "The latter trod softly and cautiously, for fear of disclosing his presence to those he trailed. Also his progress was still further delayed by the spectacle of the ancient dead in the hall of mummies. Curiously he examined these men whom history had told about, and for whom history had stopped there in the antechamber of the Maya gods. Especially curious was he at the sight of the mummy at the end of the line. The resemblance to him was too striking for him not to see, and he could not but believe that he was looking upon some direct great-ancestor of his.", "sha256": "517c56c58cb63c45082c4ce6669c90df1e3dfa4560af76a9660471e45e243e2f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1393]", "source_html": "

The resemblance to him was too striking for him not to see, and he could not but believe that he was looking upon some direct great-ancestor of his.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0062", "tag": "p", "text": "Still gazing and speculating, he was warned by approaching foot-steps, and glanced about for some place to hide. A sardonic humor seized him. Taking the helmet from the head of his ancient kin, he placed it on his own head. Likewise did he drape the rotten mantle about his form, and equip himself with the great sword and the great floppy boots that almost fell to pieces as he pulled them on. Next, half tenderly, he deposited the nude mummy on its back in the dark shadows behind the other mummies. And, finally, in the same spot at the end of the line, his hand resting on the sword-hilt, he assumed the same posture he had observed of the mummy.", "sha256": "05e9aefadb09c9f8c87b0087d99ed1571d69d2e968bec977456cb27959ad5687", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1394]", "source_html": "

At sight of Torres he came to an abrupt stop and with wide eyes of dread muttered a succession of Maya prayers. Torres, so confronted, could only listen with closed eyes and conjecture. When he heard the peon move on he stole a look and saw him pause with apprehension at the narrow elbow-turn of the passage which he must venture next. Only his eyes moved as he observed the peon venturing slowly and fearfully along the avenue of upright corpses. At sight of Torres he came to an abrupt stop and with wide eyes of dread muttered a succession of Maya prayers. Torres, so confronted, could only listen with closed eyes and conjecture. Torres saw his chance and swung the sword aloft for the blow that would split the peon’s head in twain.
